name: BookYolo
description: BookYolo is an AI-powered travel tool designed to help you inspect the quality of hotels and vacation rentals before you actually book them. The platform analyzes public listing information and guest feedback to surface hidden red flags, review patterns, overselling and marketing techniques, fee surprises and expectation gaps that travelers often miss. BookYolo goes beyond ratings and surface level reviews by running a deep analysis of each property through a 100-point inspection that focuses on reviews patterns and authenticity, cleanliness and hygiene, maintenance and functionality, comfort and sleep, check-in and access, host/staff reliability and policies, accuracy and expectation fit, safety and surroundings, value and fees, trends and consistency.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BookYolo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BookYolo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.bookyolo.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BookYolo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BookYolo provides these MCP tools: bookyolo_get_account, bookyolo_scan_property, and bookyolo_search_properties.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BookYolo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BookYolo in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
BookYolo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BookYolo is developed by BookYolo Pte. Ltd.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
